items.q: like old Carl and the piano player. What's his name? Alan.

ctx.x: That's what I was telling them. I said, can you improvise. I said can you get up and just play a saloon? You all sit up and talk about that you know what's happening with jazz. You've got these kids, the first thing you ask some of them kids when they do some of them clinics, ask some of them kids what you want to play. "Giant Steps." "Giant Steps?" I said wait a minute, let's hit some blues right here. G-major right in there, just put it right in there. They'd be stepping all over it. That's the reason I'd be…
